imageSearch.title: Image search
imageSearch.description: Use Brave Image Search to give the assistant real images and sources. The key is stored on this workspace's server.
imageSearch.enterKey: Enter a Brave Image Search API key
imageSearch.managedByEnvironment: This key is managed by an environment variable. Update the service configuration.
imageSearch.unavailable: Until a key is set, the assistant will say that image search is unavailable.
imageSearch.saved: Image search key saved. The service is checked on the next search.

htmlBlocks.title: Interactive pages
htmlBlocks.description: Let the assistant put small pages you can click in a reply. A page runs in isolation: it cannot use the network or read app data, and it can only fill the input. You decide whether to send.
htmlBlocks.allow: Allow the assistant to use interactive pages
htmlBlocks.cdnLabel: Origins allowed to load scripts and styles
htmlBlocks.cdnHint: One https origin per line, for example https://cdn.jsdelivr.net. Only pinned versions can be loaded. Every other network request is blocked.

skillsCard.title: Skills
skillsCard.description: Create, import, and manage skills for the AI assistant.

mobileNavigation.title: Features
mobileNavigation.description: Choose shortcuts for the phone tab bar and drag to reorder. More stays pinned on the right.
mobileNavigation.atCapacity: You can show at most {{max}} shortcuts. Turn one off before turning another on.
mobileNavigation.saveFailed: Couldn't save. The previous settings were restored.
mobileNavigation.reorderHint: Drag a handle to reorder. Or focus a handle, press Space to pick it up, move it with the arrow keys, and press Space to drop it.

modelSettings.title: Model settings
modelSettings.description: Configure an OpenAI Chat Completions compatible service. The connection is tested before saving.
modelSettings.clearKeyDescription: Chat can't use the current model configuration until you add an API key again.

backup.title: Backup and restore
backup.description: A snapshot includes all workspace data (tasks, materials, conversations, and memory). Merge adds records that are missing and keeps ids that already exist here. Replace swaps the current database for the snapshot.
backup.mergeDescription: Existing ids stay as they are. Records missing here are added, and records that exist only here are kept. Settings and the login session stay put, and the service does not restart. A backup is saved first.
backup.replaceDescription: Current data is backed up first, then replaced with the snapshot. The service restarts briefly during the restore.

sync.title: Sync conflicts
sync.description: When two devices change the same field, the value that arrived first stays. You can keep the later value, or keep the one already stored. Different fields merge on their own. Keys and local commands stay out.
sync.pairDescription: On the computer you want to align, open the Data page in local mode and paste this credential. It is shown only once.
sync.tokenOnce: Copy it now. It cannot be shown again after you leave this page.
sync.bindDescription: Paste the credential created on the server. The first alignment matches by id. A record that exists on only one side is copied. When the same record differs, the server keeps its value and the difference is listed on this page.
sync.alignDescription: Missing records are copied. When the same record differs, the server keeps its value and lists the difference. Keys and local commands stay here.
sync.aligned: First alignment is done. Later changes follow the log.
sync.ready: Aligned with {{url}}. Later changes follow the log.
sync.waiting: Credential for {{url}} is saved. The first alignment is not done.
sync.offline: Sync is unavailable. Local changes are saved and will retry automatically.
sync.archiveDescription: Original records are preserved when versions differ. Open one to compare; current content is retained.

server.title: Server
server.serverMode: Connected to a self-hosted server. Every device shares this data.
server.localMode: Using data on this device. A phone or browser on the server shares the server copy. To align this computer, paste a credential from the server on the Data page.

cli.title: Local AI commands
cli.description: Find the Codex and Claude Code launch commands from the login shell. A manual absolute path takes priority, and auto-check will not overwrite it.
cli.keptManual: Kept the manual configuration. Auto-check also found: {{found}}
cli.restored: Switched back to the auto-discovered command.

card.snapshot: This is a snapshot from the last report.
card.concurrencyHint: Up to {{max}} at once. A round can use fewer.
card.diskLow: Leasing pauses when free space is under 2 GB.
card.locationOffline: The computer is offline. Verification runs when it is back.
card.remoteNote: Allowed directories and concurrency are changed in that computer's config.json or command-line arguments.
card.oldVersion: This computer did not report a version. After you disconnect it, stop the process on that computer yourself.

add.title: Add computer
add.name: Name
add.once: The token is shown only once. After you close this, you can regenerate the command.
add.commandHint: Run the command below on that computer. Allowed directories can be changed only there.
add.pairTimeout: This computer has not reported a start result yet

reissue.title: Issue a new token
reissue.regenerate: The old token stops working immediately, the running process exits, and in-progress tasks are cancelled. The new command is shown only once.
reissue.modify: A new token will be issued. The old token stops working immediately, in-progress tasks are cancelled, and the old process exits. Concurrency stays at 2. This computer then asks for allowed directories and starts again.

disconnect.localIntro: This stops the process on this computer, deletes the local configuration (server, token, and allowed directories), and revokes the token.
disconnect.remoteIntro: A remote computer cannot be stopped from here. After you revoke it, the next time it connects it is told to exit. An old version has to be stopped on that computer.
disconnect.pauseNote: Running orchestrations that use this computer pause. To continue, dispatch again and choose another computer.
disconnect.worktrees: Worktrees are not cleaned up here.
disconnect.notStopped: The token is revoked. This computer has not confirmed that the process stopped.
disconnect.remoteDone: Revoked. This computer exits the next time it connects.

revoked.deleteDescription: This deletes the disconnected record only. The name stays in history.
revoked.deleteLocations: This computer still has project locations. Confirming removes those locations too.

notifications.title: System notifications
notifications.toggle: Notify when an orchestration is awaiting acceptance or paused
notifications.supportDesktop: The desktop app shows system notifications
notifications.supportGranted: The browser allows notifications (shown when this page is in the background)
notifications.supportDenied: The browser denied notification permission. Allow it in the browser settings.
notifications.supportUnsupported: This browser does not support system notifications
